title: llm-agentforge-cli
_comment: gd-tool-harness manifest. Risk is per invocation shape: anything that can remove a folder has its own Destructive id. Register this repo via a junction under D:\Repos\Tools or a manifestRoots entry in config.global.json.

tools.name: Agentforge: diagnose project
tools.description: Vault resolution, per-target doc and skills-link health for a project. Writes nothing. Run: gdt -Run af-doctor -- --path <project>

tools.name: Agentforge: list skill sources
tools.description: Registered sources (~/.agentforge/repos.json), fetch state, revision and discovered skill counts.

tools.name: Agentforge: fetch git sources
tools.description: Clone or fast-forward every registered git source into ~/.agentforge/repos. Never touches the merged view or any project. Safe to schedule.

tools.name: Agentforge: rebuild merged skills view
tools.description: Discover skills across the vault and fetched sources and rebuild ~/.agentforge/merged-skills by staged swap. Preview lists collisions and counts.

tools.name: Agentforge: bootstrap a project
tools.description: Write CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md and link <dot>/skills to the vault. Preserves existing docs and skills; refuses to merge into a folder linked elsewhere. Run: gdt -Run af-init -Apply -- --path <project> --target claude

tools.name: Agentforge: REPOINT or REPLACE a project's skills folder
tools.description: Removes an existing <dot>/skills link or directory and relinks it to the vault. A link is removed without touching its target; an ordinary directory is deleted.

tools.name: Agentforge: unregister a source
tools.description: Removes a source from repos.json and deletes its cached clone (git sources only, inside the managed cache). Never touches a registered local path.
